name: clean_browser_cache
description: Clear Chrome, Edge, and Firefox cache files
task_prompt:
Write a Python script to clear browser caches on Windows using shutil.rmtree:
  Chrome:  %LOCALAPPDATA%\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Cache
           %LOCALAPPDATA%\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Code Cache
  Edge:    %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Default\Cache
           %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Default\Code Cache
  Firefox: find profile folder in %APPDATA%\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\            and clear cache2\entries inside it
For each: measure size before, delete, report MB freed. Skip paths that do not exist. Print total MB freed.
